courseGroups.title: Required courses · both pathways
courseGroups.description: COMP844 Advanced Cybercrime and Cybersecurity (30); COMP832 Digital Forensics Tools and Techniques (15); ENGE817 STEM Research Methods (15). AUT describes the programme as academic study with practical labs and workshops.

courseGroups.title: Coursework pathway electives
courseGroups.codes: Choose four courses, subject to points and availability
courseGroups.description: AUT lists four elective selections from COMP816 Internet of Things and Applications (15), COMP821 Information Security (15), COMP830 Cryptography and Cryptanalysis (15), COMP833 Network Security and Forensics (15), COMP842 Applied Blockchains and Cryptocurrencies (15), COMP843 Advanced Cyber Forensics (30), INFS803 Cloud Computing (15), and INFS813 IT Strategy and Policy (15). Because COMP843 carries 30 points while the programme totals 180, confirm the permitted combination and point calculation with AUT before enrolment.

courseGroups.title: Coursework dissertation
courseGroups.description: One-semester dissertation. AUT requires a B− average and an approved research proposal before enrolment. Plan for a defensible research question, ethics, method, evaluation, reproducibility and written argument.

courseGroups.title: Thesis pathway electives
courseGroups.codes: Choose two courses, subject to points and availability
courseGroups.description: AUT lists two elective selections from COMP816, COMP821, COMP830, COMP833, COMP842, COMP843 (30 points), INFS803 and INFS813. Verify the allowed combination and point total with AUT; availability and prerequisites can change.

courseGroups.title: Thesis
courseGroups.description: Two-semester thesis. AUT requires a B− average and an approved postgraduate research proposal. Confirm pathway rules and enrolment with AUT.
